def rightPadSpace(s: str, width: int) -> str:
    n = len(s)
    m = width
    if n >= m:
        return s
    diff = m - n
    result = s
    i = 0
    while i < diff:
        result = result + " "
        i = i + 1
    return result

def main() -> None:
    test_cases = [
        ("hello", 10),
        ("world", 5),
        ("", 3),
        ("abc", 0),
        ("test", 7),
        ("longword", 4),
        (" ", 5),
        ("pad", -2),
        ("x", 1),
        ("y", 10)
    ]
    for s, w in test_cases:
        print(repr(rightPadSpace(s, w)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
